peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 3.8% below its local comparables; 16 of 34 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (63.6): 4.2 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 28 of 44 similar developments. Context, not scored: resales in 66.7% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $2,850,000 ($2,074 psf, 1,334–1,442 sq ft; 5 resales, Aug 2024–Jul 2026); 3 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,155 psf (range $2,001–2,537); 3.8% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $111,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Nicoll Highway MRT about 180 m, Bugis MRT about 510 m; closer than 27 of 44 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 2 within 2 km; nearest ST. Margaret's School (Primary) about 1,810 m; more than 0 of 44 similar developments (the same as 28). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 6 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 580 m), more than 19 of 44 similar developments (the same as 2); nearest hawker centre Golden Mile Food Centre about 390 m; nearest park Kallang Riverside Park about 770 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 7 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Aurea, 39 new sales, about 530 m; Midtown Modern, 1 new sales, about 570 m; Midtown Bay, 4 new sales, about 660 m; The Collective at One Sophia, 16 new sales, about 1,420 m; Duet @ Emily, 3 new sales, about 1,460 m; Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 1,580 m; Orchard Sophia, 13 new sales, about 1,760 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 108 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 77 new sales and 419 resales (496 purchases); new sales were 15.5% of these purchases. Subsales (39) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Kallang Close GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,520 m; upcoming Sophia Meadow development, about 1,790 m; Dorset Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,880 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 419 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 26 of 44 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 419 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 458 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−8.5%). Planning-area private resales −0.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
